method: Reviewed each displayed sentence and all four choices item by item, independently determining the reduced-clause form required by the main-clause subject before comparing with the stored key/explanation. Checked unique-answer validity, sentence naturalness, target-skill fit, distractor plausibility, subject-control consistency, and explanation consistency. The persisted candidate format co-locates keys with stems, so strict technical answer-blinding cannot be guaranteed in this connector-only path; no item was approved without individual review.
notes: All 25 items require an active present-participle reduced clause whose understood subject is the main-clause subject. Each item has one defensible -ing form among the four choices; no dangling-subject conflict or competing natural answer was found. Sentence naturalness, distractor plausibility, target-skill fit, and explanation consistency were checked item by item. Full cross-bank semantic near-duplicate clearance remains outstanding.
